subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Second Crack: Into Dark Territory
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Second Crack: Into Dark Territory.

hook.text: Second crack comes at about 224°C—a quieter, crackly sound. It means the bean's cell walls are collapsing.

buildup.text: Oils migrate to the bean's surface, giving it a shiny, slick appearance. The structure breaks down more aggressively.

discovery.text: Between first and second crack is where medium-dark roasts live. Past second crack is true dark roast territory.

twist.text: Going deep into second crack approaches the point of combustion. Push too far and the beans literally catch fire.

climax.text: Dark roast fans love the bold, smoky, bitter profile. But origin flavors from the bean itself are mostly destroyed.

punchline.text: Second crack is the edge. Past it, the roast speaks louder than the bean.

quiz.question: What happens to the bean's oils during second crack?
options: They migrate to the surface, giving a shiny appearance
